test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about ‘Swachh Survekshan - Urban’ is INCORRECT?

options.text: It was launched as part of the Swachh Bharat Abhiyan.
The first survey was undertaken in 2016.
It is an annual survey of cleanliness, hygiene and sanitation in cities and towns across India.
It is conducted by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is conducted by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Swachh Survekshan - Urban is conducted by the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**.
 
• It was** introduced by MoHUA in 2016** as a competitive framework to encourage cities to improve the **status of urban sanitation while encouraging large-scale citizen participation**.
 
• It is the world's** largest urban sanitation and cleanliness survey**.
 
• It was first conducted in** 2016 in 73 cities **having a population of one million or more and the capital city of States/ UTs and Mysore had bagged the award of being the cleanest city in India.**​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Prime Minister launched the** Swachh Bharat Mission Urban 2.0 on 1st October 2021, with a vision of Garbage Free Cities**.
 
• The** theme of Swachh Survekshan 2023 **is** ‘Waste to Wealth’**, which is aligned with **SBMU 2.0’s commitment to promoting circularity in waste management**.
 
• The **ranking of Wards **within the cities is also being promoted through Swachh Survekshan 2023.
 
• 
 
In the Cleanest City category of the Swachh Survekshan Results 2021, **Indore city got 1st place in the country, while Surat and Vijayawada got second and third place respectively**.
